output.reason: The evidence supports that, in cases other than those in para 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges (if any) are “as per the approved policy of a UCB” (para 261(5) residual clause). It also supports that, for term loans, any pre-payment charges are based on the amount being prepaid. However, the evidence does not show that these rules are specifically the “in-force” rules for a Tier 3 UCB (it only references a fictional/illustrative example tiering), so that part of the claim is not fully supported.
